title: AutoPlay
description: Requeue keybind and automatic requeuing features for Hypixel
body:
Hypixel mod to help with requeueing and party management

To see commands run /autoplay help

Features:
- Customizable keybind to rejoin a game
- Toggleable automatic mode to rejoin whenever everyone in your party dies or game ends 
- Automatically keeps track of party members  
- Alternate mode to alternate between chosen games  
- Random mode to play a random game 
- Nick support (linking a username to a nick has to be done manually)
- Automatically warps party members when needed
